title: Raja Yoga
author: Swami Vivekananda
description: Swami Vivekananda introduces the discipline of Raja Yoga through concentration, meditation and the training of the mind. The work connects practical exercises with the philosophical pursuit of self-knowledge and liberation.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection.
rights: First published 1896; public domain in the USA as a pre-1929 publication. Rights can vary by country.
